name_en: Sushiko — glutinous rice fermented with pickled vegetables
summary_ja: 蒸したもち米に赤しそやキャベツ、きゅうりの古漬けを合わせて重石をかけ、乳酸発酵させる「ごはんの漬物」。津軽地方西北部の米どころで冬の保存食として育まれ、農作業の合間の栄養補給にもされた。
summary_en: Steamed glutinous rice is mixed with red shiso, cabbage and aged pickled cucumber and left under a weight to lacto-ferment — a "pickled rice" from rice-rich northwestern Tsugaru, once a winter preserve and field-work snack.

name_ja: キャベツとマスの漬物
name_en: Cabbage and trout pickle — a fish-and-vegetable preserve from inland Tsugaru
summary_ja: 塩漬けにしたキャベツと、酢と酒で臭みを抜いたマスを甘酒だれで合わせ漬ける。海産物が乏しかった津軽内陸部で、保存のきく塩マスを余さず使う知恵から生まれた漬物である。
summary_en: Salted cabbage is pickled together with trout that has been de-fished in vinegar and sake, dressed with a sweet amazake-based brine — born inland in Tsugaru, where seafood was scarce and preserved trout was used to the last scrap.
source_title: キャベツとマスの漬物 青森県
